correctness.rationale: For reversible random walk, K=(1/(2m)) Σ_{i<j}deg(i)deg(j)R_ij by commute times and random-target lemma. Unit-cycle resistances are k(n−k)/n. The added chord is a rank-one Laplacian conductance update: R′_ij=R_ij−(v_i−v_j)²/(1+d(n−d)/n), with piecewise-linear unit-current potential v. Summing weighted resistances and potential variance with endpoint degree 3 gives displayed rational Δ. Its numerator is strictly negative for r=d(n−d)≥2(n−2), and derivative of full quotient equals −[(n+4)r²+2n(n+4)r+2n²−n]/[6(n+1)(n+r)²]<0. At maximal r~n²/4, Δ~−n²/24 vs K(C_n)~n²/6.
